events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi. This is Maria Alvarez, born 03/14/1968. I ran out lisinopril this morning. Can you just approve the refill right now so I can pick it up today?
One moment while I check your details.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, lisinopril ten milligram tablets, one tablet once a day, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Yes. Send it. So it's approved. Right? Can go to the pharmacy this afternoon?
Right, I'll send that request for review.
Your request reference is R Q, five six five seven. It is awaiting prescribing team review, so it is not an approval or a pharmacy pickup confirmation.
